summary: Peach County, GA entry on the Georgia lookout list (GA104, tag gfc-336); not on the NHLR Georgia register; no build date, agency, fire history or site status in the sources found.

evidence.supports: list entry: number, name, coordinates, Peach County, elevation (no unit) and tag
NHLR Georgia page says 29 lookouts are registered in Georgia; Fort Valley is not in its list
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The list entry GA104 is the only source for the tower itself. The NHLR Georgia page (29 registered lookouts, names read in full) has no Fort Valley entry, which the story states as a fact about the register. The brief's register label 'GFC US 336' appears to match the list's gfc-336 tag; not verified and not used. Leads not used in the story: a Fire Tower Road in Fort Valley, and a directory listing of a Georgia Forestry Commission Peach County office at 305 Fire Tower Road; no source found ties a tower to either. The Forest Lookouts Georgia index text read did not show a Fort Valley or Peach County entry (partial read, not a full check). The Wikipedia Fort Valley article had nothing on lookouts. The story is about 110 words, under the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin; it has not been padded. Research: two WebSearch calls and about six page reads.
